# One template per block; {k} is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== outside bas
Sub P(o As Object)
{k}
End Sub
=== inwith bas
Sub P(o As Object)
With o
{k}
End With
End Sub
=== afterif bas
Sub P(o As Object)
If o Is Nothing Then {k}
End Sub
=== aftercolon bas
Sub P(o As Object)
With o
x = 1: {k}
End With
End Sub
